note: Standing memory of tracked threads. The morning run appends to log (newest last), sets status, and never deletes entries. Citations [n] in t refer to the edition that added the entry; the same sources are copied into src so links keep working.

log.t: France 11–12 Oct, then seven countries 1–2 Nov including a SE distribution centre. Belgian criminal case open. [2, 45]
src: Suspected cyberattacks trigger supermarket fridge failures across Europe

log.t: Germany (Reisbach, Wuppertal, Raesfeld) and Portugal (seven Intermarché stores) added: at least 11 countries since 1 Nov. Commissioner Hansen calls it a deliberate attempt to disrupt the food supply; US officials privately suspect Iran-linked hackers for the commissary hits; Rome's crisis meeting found limited impact in Italy. [34, 35, 36, 44, 45, 47]

Poland's security council met on a base Warsaw would pay $3–4 billion for; Sikorski says Washington will decide by December. [51, 52, 53, 55, 56]

log.t: The revised plan went to the Kamer on 3 Nov: the vrijheidsbijdrage (a €347 million labour tax for defence) is scrapped for 2027, the new box-3 tax moves to 2029 and the VAT rise on flowers is dropped. Debate 4 Nov, vote 12 Nov; no majority yet. [8, 110]
